svg.title: How BioTSR 1.0.0 is organised
svg.desc: Inputs (PDB-format structures and run or batch requests) reach one shared TSR core through the command line or the Python API. The core reads, selects points, forms triangles, orders vertices, measures, bins and encodes keys under one standard profile per method, with modifiers as options. Results are four files with two fingerprints; analysis offers common keys on the command line and similarity and clustering in Python.
